IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Schindler, Ahern, Woods, Dunn and Kretz

IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Local Government.

Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding cities and counties that plan under the growth management act from the state environmental policy act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the applicability of chapter 43.21C RCW tocities and counties planning under RCW 36.70A.040; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The requirements of this chapter do not apply to cities andcounties that plan under RCW 36.70A.040.
